title: Broadridge Financial Solutions (BR) Fell Amid Concerns Over AI Disruption and Tokenized Equities

content_html:
Soumya Eswaran

Fri, July 24, 2026 at 9:18 AM EDT 4 min read

SouthernSun Asset Management, LLC, an investment management firm, released its "SouthernSun Smid Cap Strategy" second-quarter 2026 investor letter. A copy of the letter can be downloaded here.  The second quarter of 2026 was influenced by the AI boom and the Iran War, impacting interest rates and consumer sentiment. Portfolio companies linked to high-value consumer purchases faced pressure but still aligned with positive earnings and trends. The SMID Cap Composite returned +12.47% gross (+12.28% net), underperforming the Russell 2500® and Russell 2500® Value, which returned 20.26% and 18.50% respectively. YTD, the composite returned 23.29% on a gross basis (22.44% net) versus 36.72% and 38.54% for the indexes, respectively. Despite overall market volatility, robust fundamentals were reported, particularly among AI-tied sectors. An underweight in speculative growth caused underperformance relative to the index in Q2, although exposure to the AI data center sector was maintained while profits were taken from AI investments. In addition, please check the Strategy's top five holdings to know its best picks in 2026.

In its Q2 2026 investor letter, SouthernSun Smid Cap Strategy highlighted Broadridge Financial Solutions, Inc. (NYSE:BR). Broadridge Financial Solutions, Inc. (NYSE:BR) is a financial technology company that provides investor communications and solutions for the financial services industry. On July 23, 2026, Broadridge Financial Solutions, Inc. (NYSE:BR) closed at $144.40 per share, reflecting a market capitalization of $16.7 billion. Broadridge Financial Solutions, Inc. (NYSE:BR) posted a one-month return of 4.69%, while its shares lost 43.08% over the past 52 weeks.

SouthernSun Small Cap Strategy stated the following regarding Broadridge Financial Solutions, Inc. (NYSE:BR) in its Q2 2026 investor update:

"Broadridge Financial Solutions, Inc. (NYSE:BR), the leading processor of proxy voting and fixed-income trading in the U.S., was a bottom contributor in the SMID Cap strategy during the second quarter despite 7% recurring revenue growth, 11% Adjusted EPS growth, and increases to full-year guidance for both recurring revenue and Adjusted EPS. Shares appear to have fallen on two longer-dated fears: that AI will erode BR's technology franchises and that tokenized equities will disintermediate its governance business. These pressures were amplified by a cut to closed-sales guidance, which we attribute to sales-cycle timing rather than demand destruction. In our view,both fears are overstated. Regarding AI, we believe it is highly unlikely that BR clients will in-source proxy processing. First, the risk/reward is sharply asymmetric: we believe the compliance and liability consequences of a failed proxy distribution far outweigh any marginal cost savings. Second, any broker-dealer attempting to turn proxy distribution into a profit center would likely invite a review of the very fee schedule that creates the opportunity. Finally, even a client determined to migrate would have to do so over years, not quarters (BR's multi-year contracts make any transition gradual). On tokenization, the SEC has affirmed that tokenized securities carry the same governance and compliance obligations as traditional equities, and the vast majority of tokenized equities will, in our view, continue to flow through broker-dealers and digital platforms that are already BR's core clients. With a conservatively leveraged balance sheet (~1.7x Net Debt/EBITDA), double-digit EPS growth guidance, and a proven management team, BR trades at just 15x fiscal 2026 Adjusted EPS, a combination we find compelling."

SouthernSun Smid Cap Strategy 在其 2026 年第二季度投资者信中重点介绍了 Broadridge Financial Solutions, Inc.（纽约证券交易所代码：BR）。 Broadridge Financial Solutions, Inc.（纽约证券交易所股票代码：BR）是一家为金融服务行业提供投资者沟通和解决方案的金融科技公司。 2026 年 7 月 23 日，Broadridge Financial Solutions, Inc.（纽约证券交易所股票代码：BR）收盘价为每股 144.40 美元，市值为 167 亿美元。 Broadridge Financial Solutions, Inc.（纽约证券交易所股票代码：BR）公布的一个月回报率为 4.69%，而其股价在过去 52 周内下跌了 43.08%。

SouthernSun Small Cap Strategy 在其 2026 年第二季度投资者更新中就 Broadridge Financial Solutions, Inc.（纽约证券交易所股票代码：BR）发表了以下声明：

“Broadridge Financial Solutions, Inc.（纽约证券交易所股票代码：BR）是美国领先的代理投票和固定收益交易处理商，尽管其经常性收入增长了 7%，调整后每股收益增长了 11%，并且经常性收入和调整后每股收益均达到全年指引，但在第二季度 SMID 资本策略中的贡献率垫底。 股价下跌似乎是由于两个较长期的担忧：人工智能将侵蚀 BR 的技术特许经营权，以及代币化股票将使其治理业务脱媒。 这些压力因结束销售指导的削减而放大，我们将其归因于销售周期时机而不是需求破坏。 我们认为，这两种担忧都被夸大了。 关于人工智能，我们认为 BR 客户端不太可能进行源代理处理。 首先，风险/回报明显不对称：我们认为代理分配失败的合规和责任后果远远超过任何边际成本节省。 其次，任何试图将代理分销转变为利润中心的经纪自营商都可能会要求对创造机会的费用表进行审查。 最后，即使客户决定迁移，也必须花费数年时间，而不是几个季度（BR 的多年合同使任何过渡都是渐进的）。 在代币化方面，SEC 确认代币化证券具有与传统股票相同的治理和合规义务，我们认为，绝大多数代币化股票将继续通过已经是 BR 核心客户的经纪自营商和数字平台流动。 凭借保守的杠杆资产负债表（约 1.7 倍净债务/EBITDA）、两位数的每股收益增长指导以及经过验证的管理团队，BR 的交易价格仅为 2026 财年调整后每股收益的 15 倍，我们认为这一组合很有吸引力。”
